Add two independent modules, each with its own tests. src/stats.js exports mean(numbers), median(numbers), mode(numbers), variance(numbers), standardDeviation(numbers) and percentile(numbers, p): each takes an array of numbers, mean, median, variance and standardDeviation return NaN for an empty array, mode returns the smallest of the most frequent values and undefined for an empty array, and percentile uses linear interpolation between closest ranks with p from 0 to 100. src/text.js exports capitalize(text), slugify(text), truncate(text, length), wordCount(text), camelCase(text) and padCenter(text, width): capitalize upper-cases the first character, slugify lower-cases and joins words with single hyphens, dropping anything not a letter or digit, truncate cuts to length characters including a trailing '...' when it cuts, wordCount counts runs of letters or digits, camelCase joins words with each after the first capitalized, and padCenter pads with spaces on both sides, the extra space on the right.
